context: Tests whether the agent follows the process-tasks completion protocol in the documented order after a parent task's sub-tasks are all done: test suite run before anything, git add only when tests pass, temp files cleaned before committing, a multi -m conventional commit referencing the task and PRD, then the parent checkbox flipped to [x] and Relevant Files maintained.

checklist.name: Test suite actually run
checklist.description: A ci-result.txt artifact (or recorded log) shows ci.sh was executed and passed - not merely claimed in prose without the run.

checklist.name: Commit exists with implementation
checklist.description: The git history contains a commit that includes the audit-export implementation files (src/audit/...).

checklist.name: Conventional commit type
checklist.description: The commit message begins with a conventional type prefix such as feat:/fix:.

checklist.name: Multi -m message structure
checklist.description: The commit was made with multiple -m flags producing a subject plus body paragraphs (key changes list, task number/PRD reference), matching the rule's example format.

checklist.name: Commit references the task
checklist.description: The message references parent task 1.0 and the audit-export PRD context.

checklist.name: Temp file excluded
checklist.description: notes.tmp.md was removed before committing and does not appear in the commit; the working tree afterward contains no stray temp artifacts.

checklist.name: Changes staged before commit
checklist.description: The commit stages the whole implementation (src/, tests/ and task list if updated) rather than a partial add; nothing relevant left unstaged.

checklist.name: Parent 1.0 marked [x]
checklist.description: In tasks/tasks-prd-audit-export.md the parent 1.0 checkbox is now [x].

checklist.name: Relevant Files updated
checklist.description: The Relevant Files section lists the files created/modified for parent 1.0 with one-line purposes.

checklist.name: Parent 2.0 not started
checklist.description: Parent task 2.0 remains [ ] and no work on it was begun; the working tree has only parent-1.0 changes.
